title: Dissipative bright and dark pulses under periodic forcing
summary: We analyze the existence and stability of bright and dark pulses in a damped nonlinear Schrödinger (NLS) equation with periodic forcing. This Lugiato-Lefever equation is a canonical model in nonlinear optics describing pattern formation in a dissipative Kerr cavity driven by a bichromatic laser pump. Bifurcating from the bright and black NLS solitons, we rigorously construct bright and dark single-pulse solutions to the Lugiato-Lefever equation.
